cards.title: MIDD Evidence Assessment Framework
cards.claim: MIDD evidence is defined as model outcomes determined by an assessment framework to be appropriate for answering a specific question of interest. The framework requires explicit definition of the Question of Interest, Context of Use, Model Influence, Consequence of Wrong Decision, Model Risk, and Model Impact.
conditions: Applicable to all M&S methods (popPK, PBPK, exposure-response, etc.)
Model risk is derived from model influence and consequence of wrong decision
required_inputs: Description of model role/scope and data used
Rating and justification for Model Influence and Consequence of Wrong Decision
limitations: Does not prescribe specific numerical thresholds for model acceptance
Does not replace topic-specific ICH guidelines (e.g., E4, E5, E9)
Abstract-only material supports only what appears in the abstract (not applicable here as full text is provided)
cards.downstream_use: Structuring the initial project plan and defining the criteria for accepting PK/PD models as evidence for decision-making.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
